title: 酸菜罈子蓋
subject: a young man carries his own three-year-old jar of pickled mustard greens to his girlfriend's flat to cook for her, and the lid will not open for him, her roommate or her brother, until she taps it once with a spoon handle
caption: Yunnan hulusi and bawu folk-pop, bouncy two-feel groove. Hulusi plays a quick bright melody over drones, bawu answers with breathy low phrases, steel-string acoustic guitar strums light offbeats, upright bass walks in plain quarter notes, shaker and wooden frame drum keep a skipping pulse. Dry close-miked wooden-room production. Male baritone, light and playful, melody clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 118 BPM, D major. Cheeky, warm kitchen mood. No electronic drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads, no heavy distortion.
lyrics:
[Intro - hulusi melody over acoustic guitar strum]

[Verse 1]
我拎著一罈三年的酸菜
一路上抱得比包還要乖
到妳家廚房我說我來
這一鍋湯我已經想很久

[Pre-Chorus]
蓋子轉一轉
咦怎麼不動

[Chorus]
蓋子蓋子轉不開
我手心都紅起來
室友來試了一下
哥哥來試了兩下

[Verse 2]
我用毛巾包著用力扭
我用熱水澆著它的頭
妳在旁邊笑得直不起腰
說三年都等了何必急

[Pre-Chorus]
妳拿起湯匙
輕輕敲一下

[Chorus]
蓋子蓋子轉開了
嘶的一聲全屋都香
我站在原地發呆
妳說原來要這樣敲

[Outro - hulusi and bawu trade a last phrase, guitar fades]
